score_interpretation: evidence-aware calibrated score; conservative email and URL safeguards prevent unsupported allow or phishing verdicts

email_evidence_floor.condition: at least one reviewed combination of corroborating warning signs
email_evidence_floor.limitation: The safeguard prevents an allow result but does not declare the email phishing.

known_https_host_mitigation.match: exact hostname after removing an optional www prefix
known_https_host_mitigation.limitation: Popularity reduces false positives but does not prove a page is safe.

unverified_url_policy.condition: hostname absent from the offline reputation snapshot and no concrete phishing indicator detected
unverified_url_policy.limitation: Live reputation and page contents are not checked.

bands.guidance: No strong phishing signal was detected; continue normal caution.
Treat the content cautiously and verify it through a trusted channel.
Do not interact with the content; send it for security review.
Block or isolate the content, subject to organizational review policy.

calibration_method: sigmoid fitted on validation data only
